text:
GeoPulse

 
 
 

 The self-hosted, source-available Google Timeline alternative. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

GeoPulse transforms raw GPS data from OwnTracks, Overland, Dawarich, GPSLogger, Home Assistant, Traccar, Colota and other sources into a
searchable timeline of stays, trips, and movement patterns. It runs fully on your own infrastructure and integrates with
 Immich , Memos , and Weather so photos, notes, and conditions appear directly on your map history.

 
 
 
 
 
 Comprehensive timeline visualization with automatic trip classification. 
 

---

 Quick installation

 

 Access: 
 Note: For production, review your .env for security-related settings first. 

Need MQTT support for OwnTracks, Kubernetes, Unraid, Proxmox or bare-metal installation? See the deployment options.

---

 Why GeoPulse

- Self-hosted, no telemetry: Your location data remains on your own infrastructure.
- Open ecosystem: Works with popular GPS apps (OwnTracks, Overland, GPSLogger, Home Assistant, Colota, Traccar) and tools like Immich, Memos, and Weather.
- Full data ownership: Import historical data and export your data in standard formats anytime.
- Lightweight runtime: Typically under 100MB RAM and under 1% CPU in regular usage.
- Accessible & Localized: Currently available in English, Ukrainian, German and Dutch, ensuring an inclusive experience across different regions.

---

 Features

 Timeline & Analysis 

- Smart Detection: Automatically converts GPS points into stays, trips, and data gaps.
- Custom Logic: Fully configurable detection sensitivity and travel mode classification.
- Deep Insights: Analytics for distance, visit frequency, and movement patterns over time.
- Map Matching: Valhalla-backed route refinement makes noisy trip paths follow roads and paths while raw GPS remains authoritative.
- Panoramax: Optional public street-level imagery coverage and photo viewing on Timeline maps.
- Immich Integration: Photos from your library appear directly on your map timeline.
- Memos Integration: Timestamped notes from Memos can appear alongside your timeline.
- Weather Integration: Current weather enrichment is enabled by default for trips, stays, map layers, and journey insights; historical backfill is admin opt-in. See Weather processing architecture.

 Sources & Syncing 

- Real-time Tracking: Supports OwnTracks (HTTP/MQTT), Overland, GPSLogger, Home Assistant, Traccar, Dawarich or Colota.
- Universal Import: Bulk import from Google Timeline, GPX, GeoJSON, OwnTracks exports, and CSV.

 AI Chat & MCP 

- AI Chat: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible key for AI-assisted insights.
- MCP Server: Read-only, API-token-authenticated tools for AI clients to query their timeline and permitted friend data.

 Sharing & Privacy 

- Friends System: Per-user visibility controls for live location and history.
- Guest Access: Shareable links with optional password protection and instant revocation.
- Multi-user Ready: Built-in invitations, roles, and admin audit logs.
- Enterprise Auth: OIDC/SSO support alongside standard username/password login.

 Platform & Performance 

- Lightweight: Typically under 100MB RAM and 1% CPU usage.
- Self-Sovereign: No telemetry, no analytics beacons, and no third-party tracking.
- Data Freedom: Full data export and per-account deletion support.
- Backup & Restore: Encrypted, password-protected full backups with manual restore and scheduled automatic backups.

---

 🏠 Home Assistant Integration

The GeoPulse for Home Assistant integration (installed via HACS) connects Home Assistant to GeoPulse with a single API token, in both directions:

- Home Assistant → GeoPulse: forward device tracker and person entities. Points are queued on disk and retried, and recorder history can be backfilled.
- GeoPulse → Home Assistant: your current stay or trip and its place, today's distance, trips and stays, a presence tracker, friends on the map, and server health.
- Automations: events for geofence enter/leave, stay/trip started/ended, and tracking lost/resumed.

Requires GeoPulse 2.0+ and Home Assistant 2026.3+. See the integration README for setup.

---

 📸 Feature Tour

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Timeline & route replay Stays, trips, and data gaps with travel modes, weather, and step-by-step trip replay. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Location Analytics Explore every visit by map, city, and country. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Dashboard Selected period, 7-day, and 30-day overviews with charts, top places, and route stats. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Rewind Monthly and yearly summaries of distance, trips, highlights, and heatmaps. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Journey Insights Countries, cities, time patterns, weather, milestones, and badges. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 City details Visit overview, top places, and every visit in a city. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Trip Plans Plan stops with travel modes and routed legs, then compare the plan with what you actually visited. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Location Sources Connect OwnTracks, Overland, GPSLogger, Home Assistant, Traccar, Dawarich, or Colota. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 GPS Data Inspect, filter, and export raw location points. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Export & Import Full backups and GPX, GeoJSON, OwnTracks, or CSV exports with a date range. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Personal Settings Language, time zone, units, map appearance, and connected apps. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Administration Instance health, usage, users, backups, and audit logs. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 System Settings Authentication, geocoding, weather, map matching, and more without restarts. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Mobile The web app works on phones and installs as a PWA. 
 
 
 

 Deployment Options

Choose the installation path that matches your environment:

 Installation type Best for Guide 
 ------------------- ---------- ------- 
 Docker Compose Fastest path for local and single-server use Docker Compose Guide 
 Unraid Unraid NAS and homelab servers using Docker Compose Unraid Guide 
 Proxmox VE LXC Proxmox homelabs and VM hosts that prefer LXC containers Proxmox VE LXC Guide 
 Kubernetes / Helm Managed clusters and production
